meta.title: Privacy Policy — AffProf
meta.description: Learn how AffProf collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our affiliate link management service.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content:
AffProf ("we", "us", "our") collects the following information when you use our service:

• Account information: email address and name when you register
• Usage data: links you create, products you add, click events on your short links
• Click analytics: country, device type, browser, and referrer source of clicks on your short links (no personally identifiable visitor information is stored)
• Payment information: handled entirely by Stripe. We never store credit card details.
• IP addresses: stored in hashed form only, never in raw format

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
We use your information to:

• Provide and operate the AffProf service
• Send email alerts when your affiliate links break
• Send transactional emails (receipts, account notices)
• Improve and develop new features
• Respond to support requests

We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Sharing
sections.content:
We share data only with:

• Stripe: for payment processing
• Resend: for transactional email delivery
• Neon/Supabase: for database hosting
• Vercel: for application hosting

All providers are contractually bound to protect your data.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.content:
• Account data is retained while your account is active
• After account deletion, data is removed within 30 days
• Click analytics are retained for 12 months

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
sections.content: AffProf uses only essential cookies required for authentication and session management. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.content:
You have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you
• Request correction of inaccurate data
• Request deletion of your account and data
• Export your data in a portable format

To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@affprof.com

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.content:
We implement industry-standard security measures including:

• Encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS)
• Hashed passwords via our authentication system
• Row-level security on our database

sections.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.content: AffProf is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you by email of significant changes.
